entities.summary: Pedro Pascual Francisco Farfán de los Godos was a Peruvian prelate of the Catholic Church who served as the 28th Archbishop of Lima from 1933 to his death in 1945. Additionally, he also served as Bishop of Cuzco from 1918 to 1933.
